text:
Maria (CS): FYI Gamma Edge is signaling a multi-squad rollout — three teams (Search, CX Assist, Personalization) want to go live next week. They reported sustained spikes in the playground: ~8k tokens/min over the last 2 hours. Asking about Dedicated pilot for latency & compliance. cc @Ben (Solutions Eng) @Oliver (Account Exec) :eyes:

Ben (Solutions Eng): Can you drop their org id and current plan? Rough calc: 8k tokens/min ≈ 11.5M tokens/day — probably need reserved pods or burst capacity. Also: did they sign any NDA / do they need private data handling? What's current monthly spend + renewal date?

Maria (CS): Org id: gamma-edge-prod-43. Current plan: hosted PAYG, no commit. Renewal: Oct 2026. Current avg monthly usage ~1.2M tokens. Main contacts: Priya (CTO) and Raj (ML Eng). They mentioned latency SLO and compliance (PII in vectors).

Oliver (Account Exec): This is a solid expansion + upsell opportunity. I can propose a 3-month Dedicated pilot (committed) to start. Priya hinted at budget next quarter. I'll draft SOW and pricing.

Sara (Enablement): Prep checklist: onboarding playbook, sample prompts, eval prompt set for quality/regression, SLO docs, and SRE contact. I can run a 45-min enablement session Wed 10am PT. Who will cover model config and autoscaling?

Ben (Solutions Eng): I'll own model config + perf tuning. Need their avg seq length and tokens/request distribution. Recommend KV cache + prefix caching for chat, and quantization for cheaper embedding runs.

Maria (CS): They pasted a short log snippet:
```
qps: 4.2
avg_seq: 512
burst: peaks to 2.1k tokens/sec
routes: /chat (70%), /embed (30%)
```
They said model is a GPT-like open model, finetuned. Goal: 95th pct latency <150ms for chat. They also want automated fallback to smaller model during peaks.

Oliver (Account Exec): Action items: Ben -> capacity + cost estimate by EOD; Sara -> invite for Wed 10am PT; Maria -> collect historical usage & security checklist; I'll draft pilot pricing and SOW. Who should we loop from Security/Infra?

Emily (Security): Loop me in. They will persist PII in vectors; need KMS + audit logs and possibly data residency. Ask if on-prem / VPC is required. I can run a security review after SOW.

Maria (CS): Priya also left feedback: wants routing policies so chat routes to high-throughput region and embeddings to cheaper region. She asked about automatic model variant fallback and per-route cost breakdown. Adding to notes.

Ben (Solutions Eng): I'll run a staging sim for their traffic pattern and post numbers here (throughput, pod counts, estimated cost with/without cache).

deploy-bot: Created pilot template: /templates/dedicated-gamma-edge. Use that as baseline for SOW and onboarding steps.

Maria (CS): Thanks everyone — I'll consolidate notes and send a one-pager to Priya today. Keeping an eye on renewal timing as a negotiation lever.
